messages.en:
{07 00 00}Having fish in my room
makes me want to live
underwater!
{07 14 00}And they look TOTALLY cool!
{01 00 00 05 00}Especially in the summer,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kalad mu toas panevad mind
tahtma vee all
elada!
{07 14 00}Ja nad näevad TÄIESTI
lahedad välja! {01 00 00 05 00}Eriti suvel,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's so nice to live like
this!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm surrounded by
fish, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0a 00}Maybe we should live UNDER
the sea!{01 00 00 05 00} Under the sea...{01 00 00 05 00}
Yeah, just you and me...
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii tore on niimoodi
elada!{01 00 00 0a 00} Olen kaladest
ümbritsetud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 0a 00}Ehk peaksime elama MERE
all!{01 00 00 05 00} Mere all...{01 00 00 05 00}
Jah, ainult sina ja mina...

messages.en:
{07 13 00}Ever since I put fish in my
room, I feel like a pretty
underwater creature!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 15 00}WHAT?!{01 01 00}
I'm more like a crusty sea
captain??!!{01 00 00 0f 00} HMPH!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Sellest ajast, kui panin
kalad tuppa, tunnen end
nagu ilus veealune olend!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 15 00}MIDA?!{01 01 00}
Pigem nagu kore
merekapten??!!{01 00 00 0f 00} HMPH!
